exposure: Mothers with multiple sclerosis who breastfed
Mothers with multiple sclerosis who did not breastfeed
outcome: Fetal biometric parameters (biparietal diameter, head circumference, abdominal circumference, and femur length)
Incidence of small for gestational age newborns
cohort: 211 women with multiple sclerosis and 384 healthy women paired for maternal age and parity as controls
finding: Multiple sclerosis in pregnancy does not seem to affect fetal growth and postnatal development during the first year of the offspring life.
mod_finding: A significantly higher incidence of caesarean section (p = 0.01) and late preterm delivery (at less than 37 weeks' gestation, p = 0.001) were registered in the multiple sclerosis group.
